$comment: Copy to ~/.config/control-center/config.json (or $CC_CONFIG_DIR/config.json). Every key is optional; missing keys use the defaults shown here. `~` and `$HOME` are expanded. Secrets do NOT go here — see .env.example.

user.$comment: How the agents refer to you, and your Atlassian identity for skills that assign tickets.
user.name: Your Name

dirs.$comment: config = state dir (agents.jsonl, inbox.jsonl, todos.json, tui.log). projects = where project directories live. skills = roots scanned for /skill-name completion in chats.

commands.$comment: agent = command typed into a tmux pane to start an AI agent (a shell alias such as cursor-cli or claude is fine — panes run your interactive shell). mkpanes = path to the mkpanes script. terminal = alacritty | terminal (macOS Terminal.app) | none. tmuxSession = session that receives new ticket windows; null = current/first.

jira.$comment: baseUrl for browse links and REST transitions. cloudId is what the Atlassian MCP tools need. sprintField is the custom field holding the sprint.

projects.$comment: Directory names under dirs.projects that are not projects.

repos.$comment: Repo alias → path for the worktrees tab and mkpanes-style launches. Leave empty to parse the alias list from the mkpanes script instead.
